info.title: Baigamats HORECA API
info.description: Restaurant & bar API. Sign in with POST /v1/auth/login, then send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Every answer (success or error) is wrapped as `{statusCode, message, payload, timestamp}`; the examples show the `payload`. Money is whole UGX. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD in Uganda time (UTC+3). The HORECA routes return 403 until the business's owner switches the API on. Roles: owner/manager (everything), cashier (takes payment), waiter (orders), kitchen (tickets).

servers.description: Replace with the DigitalOcean address of the API

tabName.description: Required for a tab, e.g. the customer name

ageVerifiedBy.description: Name of the staff member who checked the customer ID. Required for age-restricted items.

phoneNumber.description: Customer Mobile Money number. Required for mobile_money.

section.description: Floor area the table belongs to
Floor area. Send an empty text to remove it.

status.description: Free, reserved for a guest, or needing cleaning. A table with an open order shows as occupied by itself.

isActive.description: false hides the item from the menu without deleting it

openingFloat.description: Cash already in the drawer, whole UGX

countedCash.description: Cash counted in the drawer, whole UGX

loginId.description: Email address, or the staff username given by the business
